predictedBugs: A live CLI could accidentally accept a service-role key merely because it was stored under the public-key variable; the shared context rejects secret prefixes, service-role JWTs and configured service-role equality before constructing a client.
Task completion and its activity event could diverge if written separately; task create and all explicit bulk transitions call atomic migration RPCs and reject malformed envelopes.
Duplicate preview and Smart List apply could materialize an unbounded contact table; both reuse the canonical workspace-scoped contact list capped at 500.
A forged actor membership could be sent to security-definer RPCs; adapters require the actor or creator to equal the resolved WorkspaceScope membership before persistence.
edgeCases: Sample scope is rejected at every Supabase adapter boundary.
Bulk reopen is rejected for more than one explicit task ID and all other bulk lists are capped at 100 unique IDs.
Replay receipts preserve noOp, noOpTaskIds and conversion action without collapsing audit truth.
Live authentication failures return a live error envelope and never construct or return a sample repository.
